model.held_fixed: family, hyperparameters, seed and the shipped column stack are the same in every variant; (b) and the combined variants read the aggregate columns in addition

stage_6_noise_band.definition: the widest paired 95 percent half-width on transaction-level PR-AUC across the row and card resamples. A promotion margin inside it promotes on noise; stage 9 sets its margin above it

guard.baseline: on: the fit rows went through data_loader.assert_train_only
guard.leaky_variants: switched off inside scripts/leakage_delta.py:guard_switched_off for the preparation fits of (a), (d) and the combined variants, and restored after

aggregation.over: every row of the dataset, all three windows, no restriction to earlier rows

postprocessing.rule: each score replaced by the mean score over the entity's rows in the scored window (validation rows with validation rows, test rows with test rows)

diagnostic.on: the baseline's scores over the chronological test window

null_key_component.rule: an entity key with 'NA' in it, ADR 0001

random_split.rule: a seeded permutation of the rows cut at the chronological row fractions

variants.description: the shipped configuration: encoders fitted on train through the guard, no entity aggregate, no post-processing, the chronological split
every encoder fitted on all rows, including the validation and test windows and their labels, at the same lag and smoothing
mean and standard deviation of the C, M and normalised D columns per entity over every row of the dataset, attached to every row of the entity
the baseline's predictions, each replaced by the mean prediction over the entity's rows in the same scored window
a seeded random permutation cut at the chronological row fractions, encoders fitted on the random train rows, scored on the random test rows
(a), (b) and (c) together on the chronological split, so the delta stays paired with the baseline
all four together: the competition-style pipeline end to end

deltas.rule: a variant inflates the metric when the 95 percent interval of its test PR-AUC difference against the baseline, on the row resample, excludes zero and the point is positive; otherwise it is recorded as a null. Chronological variants are paired on identical resamples; the random-split variants are scored on different rows and their interval is the difference of independent draws

pr_auc_by_row.resample: independent: the variant is scored on the random test rows, the baseline on the chronological ones
